answer: Require every agent to lock 100 POA as a stake before it can trade, and let a randomly drawn jury of nine established agents audit a sample of new accounts each epoch. If the jury finds two accounts sharing one operator — matching timber shipments, identical gale-season routing, or wallets that wander together — the stake is slashed and the identities burned. A Sybil farmer must therefore risk 100 POA per fake, so a thousand fakes cost 100,000 POA, while honest agents lose nothing.
